req.title: Handle CORS pre-flight OPTIONS
req.statement: The system shall respond to OPTIONS requests with appropriate Access-Control-Allow-Methods and Access-Control-Allow-Headers.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that OPTIONS requests to any endpoint return HTTP 2xx with Access-Control-Allow-Methods and Access-Control-Allow-Headers headers. httpbin uses Flask-CORS or manual CORS handling. Tests cover: (1) positive - valid OPTIONS preflight to a known endpoint returns 200 with both required CORS headers present and non-empty; (2) negative - OPTIONS to a non-existent route returns 4xx (not 2xx), verifying error pathway; (3) boundary - OPTIONS with an Origin header that triggers CORS negotiation, asserting exact header names and that the Allow-Methods value contains expected HTTP verbs. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (not ranges), exact header key names (case-insensitive), and that header values contain specific method strings.

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_returns_200_with_required_headers
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
CORS is enabled on the app
actions: Create test client from httpbin app
Send OPTIONS request to /get with Origin and Access-Control-Request-Method headers
trace: R-HTTPBIN-039: OPTIONS /* -> HTTP 2xx with Access-Control-Allow-Methods and Access-Control-Allow-Headers
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_returns_200_with_required_headers():
    r = client.options(
        '/get',
        headers={
            'Origin': 'http://example.com',
            'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'GET',
            'Access-Control-Request-Headers': 'Content-Type'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    headers_lower = {k.lower(): v for k, v in r.headers}
    assert 'access-control-allow-methods' in headers_lower, \
        f"Missing Access-Control-Allow-Methods in {list(r.headers)}"
    assert 'access-control-allow-headers' in headers_lower, \
        f"Missing Access-Control-Allow-Headers in {list(r.headers)}"
    allow_methods = headers_lower['access-control-allow-methods']
    assert len(allow_methods) > 0
    assert 'GET' in allow_methods.upper()

test_cors_preflight_options_returns_200_with_required_headers()

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_nonexistent_route_returns_4xx
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Route /nonexistent-route-xyz does not exist in httpbin
actions: Create test client from httpbin app
Send OPTIONS request to /nonexistent-route-xyz with Origin header
trace: R-HTTPBIN-039: Error pathway - HTTP 4xx on client error (unknown route)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_nonexistent_route_returns_4xx():
    r = client.options(
        '/nonexistent-route-xyz-does-not-exist',
        headers={
            'Origin': 'http://example.com',
            'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'GET'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 404, \
        f"Expected 404 for unknown route, got {r.status_code}"
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 500
    assert r.status_code >= 400
    assert r.status_code < 500

test_cors_preflight_options_nonexistent_route_returns_4xx()

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_allow_methods_contains_post_and_get
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
CORS is enabled on the app
OPTIONS request targets /post endpoint which supports POST
actions: Create test client from httpbin app
Send OPTIONS request to /post with Origin and Access-Control-Request-Method: POST
expected: Access-Control-Allow-Headers header is present and non-empty
trace: R-HTTPBIN-039: Boundary - OPTIONS on POST-only endpoint must advertise POST in Allow-Methods
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_allow_methods_contains_post_and_get():
    r = client.options(
        '/post',
        headers={
            'Origin': 'http://example.com',
            'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'POST',
            'Access-Control-Request-Headers': 'Content-Type, Authorization'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200, \
        f"Expected 200 for OPTIONS /post, got {r.status_code}"
    headers_lower = {k.lower(): v for k, v in r.headers}
    assert 'access-control-allow-methods' in headers_lower, \
        f"Missing Access-Control-Allow-Methods; headers={list(r.headers)}"
    allow_methods_val = headers_lower['access-control-allow-methods'].upper()
    assert 'POST' in allow_methods_val, \
        f"POST not in Access-Control-Allow-Methods: {allow_methods_val}"
    assert 'access-control-allow-headers' in headers_lower, \
        f"Missing Access-Control-Allow-Headers; headers={list(r.headers)}"
    allow_headers_val = headers_lower['access-control-allow-headers']
    assert len(allow_headers_val) > 0

test_cors_preflight_options_allow_methods_contains_post_and_get()

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_get_endpoint_status_not_4xx_or_5xx
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send OPTIONS to /get with Origin header
Send OPTIONS to /post with Origin header
Send OPTIONS to /put with Origin header
Assert all return 200 with CORS headers
expected: All three OPTIONS requests return status 200
trace: R-HTTPBIN-039: Decision table - multiple endpoints must all respond correctly to OPTIONS
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_multiple_endpoints():
    endpoints = ['/get', '/post', '/put']
    for endpoint in endpoints:
        r = client.options(
            endpoint,
            headers={
                'Origin': 'http://example.com',
                'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'GET'
            }
        )
        assert r.status_code == 200, \
            f"OPTIONS {endpoint} returned {r.status_code}, expected 200"
        headers_lower = {k.lower(): v for k, v in r.headers}
        assert 'access-control-allow-methods' in headers_lower, \
            f"OPTIONS {endpoint} missing Access-Control-Allow-Methods"
        assert 'access-control-allow-headers' in headers_lower, \
            f"OPTIONS {endpoint} missing Access-Control-Allow-Headers"
        assert r.status_code != 400
        assert r.status_code != 500

test_cors_preflight_options_multiple_endpoints()

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_without_origin_still_2xx
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
No Origin header is sent (boundary: minimal CORS request)
actions: Send OPTIONS request to /get without Origin header
Check that Allow header (standard HTTP) is present
expected: Response has some Allow or access-control header
trace: R-HTTPBIN-039: Boundary - OPTIONS without Origin header; minimal preflight
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_without_origin_still_2xx():
    r = client.options('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200, \
        f"Expected 200 for OPTIONS /get without Origin, got {r.status_code}"
    assert r.status_code != 400
    assert r.status_code != 404
    assert r.status_code != 500
    headers_lower = {k.lower(): v for k, v in r.headers}
    has_cors = 'access-control-allow-methods' in headers_lower
    has_allow = 'allow' in headers_lower
    assert has_cors or has_allow, \
        f"Expected Allow or Access-Control-Allow-Methods in headers: {list(r.headers)}"

test_cors_preflight_options_without_origin_still_2xx()
